deadline.intake: September 2027, international pathway (final round; earlier rounds 4 Nov 2026 and 13 Jan 2027)

tuition.note: full annual fee, fiscal residence outside EEA, 2026-2027

requirement.text: Apply via the international pathway with a foreign secondary diploma (IB, A-levels, etc.); application fee EUR 150; motivation texts must be written in the language of each chosen programme (French or English at regional campuses). No IELTS minimum was verified.
